title: Freemax Maxpod Replacement Pod
description: The Freemax Maxpod Replacement Pod is a convenient and versatile accessory for the Freemax Maxpod Kit, designed to deliver exceptional flavour and performance. Each pod features a 2ml e-liquid capacity, making it fully TPD-compliant, and incorporates Freemax’s innovative patented mesh coil technology for a smooth and satisfying vape. These pods are available with either a pre-installed NS Mesh 1.0ohm coil for a balanced Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) experience or a 1.5ohm coil for a more restricted MTL draw. Both options are optimised for use with high-PG, 50/50, or nic salt e-liquids, ensuring excellent flavour and vapour production. Refilling is quick and mess-free, thanks to the side-fill panel, and replacing the coil is as simple as using the push-to-fit system. Designed for ease of use and incredible performance, the Freemax Maxpod Replacement Pods are the ideal choice for vapers seeking reliability and outstanding flavour.
